decision_time_provenance.source: time.time_ns() sampled at analyzer process start

limitations: Program references are structural exposures inside verified selected blocks only; a zero means no reference in those blocks, not global absence.
Program IDs are not market identities, pools, trades, births, or evidence of cross-slot population continuity.
Only the program ID independently pinned by the official Pump AMM IDL receives a venue label; all other IDs remain unknown_program.
Transaction status comes from captured meta.err and does not establish execution settlement or economic effect.
Capture receipt time is not availability time; blockTime is nullable event time; decision time is recorded separately.

replay_measurements.measurement_scope: analyzer Python process; zstd child CPU/RSS not included

scope.availability_time_rule: null unless independently present in the sealed receipt; never infer from event or receipt time
